answer.reason: Judges 18 tells what happened to Laish: the Danites destroyed it and renamed it Dan.

clauses.english: was attacked by the Danites, its people put to the sword and the city burned
clauses.quote: they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire

clauses.english: was rebuilt by the Danites and renamed Dan
clauses.quote: they called the name of the city Dan

doubts: ISA 10:30 places a Laish near Gallim and Anathoth in Benjamin, which may be a different place from the northern Laish of Judges 18; I left it out and used only Judges 18.
